summary: VICI Properties L.P. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a public offering of senior notes due in two tranches. Proceeds will repay existing 2026 maturities ($480.5M, $19.5M, $1.25B) and for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, with a pledge of limited partnership interests; no listing planned. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
